name: Infinite Inertial Skew Carousel
description: Full-screen infinite image carousel driven by wheel and drag with inertia. Cards skew, rotate and shrink with speed, and turn from grayscale to color with a number on hover.
contents: Row of image cards with a two-digit index shown on hover
behavior: Infinite looping horizontal track with lerped inertia
Mouse wheel and mouse or touch drag move the track
Cards skew, rotate and scale according to scroll speed
Hover turns the image from grayscale to color, zooms it and reveals the index number
editableByProps: Images, number of cards and alt text

needsCodeEdit.change: Change skew, rotation or scale response
needsCodeEdit.where: skewValue, rotateValue and scaleValue constants in renderLoop
item div className with w-[70vw] sm:w-[45vw] md:w-[30vw]

fixed: Listens to window wheel events and uses them to move the track, without blocking page scroll
Index numbers use the Playball Google font imported inside the component
